Comprehensive report · 861 existing stores + network-wide adds · Quality Stack methodology

Executive Summary

Final capped allocation: 973 doors in test across Test 1 / 2A / 2B / 3, with 850 doors excluded and 507 of the original 508 3-Rack doors protected (store 3280 removed by request). We scanned a universe of 1,823 candidate stores (861 existing) and ranked by a blended composite of Quality Stack pass and D34 GMV percentile.

Key Actions

  • Place 74 High-Income + Quality-Stack doors into Test 3 — SN + FA Racks.
  • Fill Test 2 (400 doors) from the top GMV-weighted composite, split evenly: 200 in 2A — TS Core + FA Fashion and 200 in 2B — TS Core + Scoop Fashion (balanced A/B by composite rank).
  • Hold Test 1 — TS + FA Racks at 500 doors — 396 from the protected 508 originals.
  • All 508 original 3-Rack doors remain protected across the buckets.

The expanded, GMV-weighted 4-bucket design
Test 3 (74 doors) is our best-stores tier — the top 74 by composite rank (GMV-inclusive Quality Stack + D34 GMV), all carrying FA Racks. Test 2 now spans 400 doors pulled from the top GMV-weighted composite, split into two statistically matched arms — 2A (TS Core + FA Fashion) and 2B (TS Core + Scoop Fashion), 200 each — so the fixture A/B reads cleanly (avg D34 GMV $2.06M vs $1.98M; avg score 4.33 vs 4.43). Test 1 (TS + FA Racks) holds the protected 508 base (396 of 500 here).

Methodology — Bucketing Rule & Quality Stack

TEST 1 — TS + FA Racks

Protected 508 base (507 after 3280 removed) + next-best composite. Standard T&S + FA Racks; 499 doors.

TEST 2A — TS Core + FA Fashion

Arm A of the 400-door Test 2. Top GMV-weighted composite, balanced A/B by rank. FA Fashion fixtures.

TEST 2B — TS Core + Scoop Fashion

Arm B of the 400-door Test 2. Statistically matched to 2A. Scoop Fashion fixtures.

TEST 3 — SN + FA Racks

Our 74 best doors — top composite rank (GMV-inclusive Quality Stack + D34 GMV), all carrying Free Assembly. The premium showcase tier.

What is the Quality Stack?

A 5-criteria filter that flags stores already behaving like premium-brand customers (FA / Scenario / T&S). Each store earns 1 point per criterion passed, for a 0–5 total. The score (GMV-inclusive) now drives the allocation composite; the strict QS = Y core flag (3/3 on the quality criteria) plus HIGH income still defines Test 3.

Thresholds = network medians from precise BigQuery data. Passing = better than half the network.

💡 Key Insight

The 508 original 3-Rack doors average ~2.6 / 5 on the GMV-inclusive Quality Stack. The 400 Test 2 doors are now split by brand fit: every Test 2A door carries & sells Free Assembly and every Test 2B door carries & sells Scoop (L12W regular sales). 40 doors scoring 4+ remain in Excluded as swap candidates; all Test 2 doors carry the 2014 WALL mod.

Quality Stack Score Distribution — 0 to 5 per Bucket

Each store gets 0–5 points for passing: D34 Markdown < 17.8%, Plus Markdown < 32.3%, D34 AUR > $10.49, D34 GMV > median, Plus GMV > median. GMV is now part of both the score AND the allocation — buckets were re-run so the GMV-weighted composite drives all four buckets. Test 2 was expanded to 400 and split into two matched arms (2A / 2B, 200 each); both arms sit almost entirely at score 4-5.
